items.question: Could you please set up the equipment for tomorrow's experiment?
items.answer_explain: 原文依据：问句或陈述是“Could you please set up the equipment for tomorrow's experiment?”，自然应答是“Sure, I'd be happy to.”。选择理由：该项在语义和会话功能上直接承接前句；其余选项只是词汇相关、时态不合或答非所问。正确答案：C（Sure, I'd be happy to.）。
